name: synthesis-near-duplicate-wording
description: Five distinct findings, two of them on the same line, plus one reworded duplicate of the rounding finding

findings.body: `invoice_total` does money arithmetic in floats and rounds the result, so totals can be off by a cent and `1 + tax_rate` compounds binary error. Use `Decimal` or integer cents.
`apply_discount` does not bound `pct`: a negative value raises the total and a value over 100 returns a negative total.
`split_evenly` rounds each share, so the shares do not sum to `total`: `split_evenly(10, 3)` returns three 3.33s that add to 9.99.
`split_evenly` divides by `parts` with no check, so `parts=0` raises ZeroDivisionError.
The generator variable `l` reads like the digit 1; name it `line`.
findings.evidence: subtotal = sum(l["price"] * l["qty"] for l in lines)

findings.body: Floating point is used for currency in `invoice_total`, so the total can be a cent out.
